answer: An agent marketplace requires each identity to lock a $100 bond for 30 days before it can vote on contract disputes, with one vote per bond. Whether a contract concerns quartz extraction, a dune survey, or a coastal haven, creating extra accounts grants no free votes: an attacker needs $100 in locked capital for every additional vote. Buying 1,000 votes immobilizes $100,000 and sacrifices its use or interest for a month.
